rendersnap.option.multi_render.tooltip: Renders chunks in an efficient way, This does not affect tps!
rendersnap.option.zoom_ease.tooltip: Changes how the zoom feels when zooming out and in
rendersnap.option.occlusion.tooltip: Uses Minecraft's section visibility graph to skip terrain hidden behind other terrains. Disable it if chunks looks weird and buggy.
rendersnap.option.faces.tooltip: Skips rendering faces between corresponding full solid blocks. Some resource packs and moving-block mods may need this off.
rendersnap.option.texture_lod.tooltip: Uses rougher sampling for chunk terrain textures. Helps weak GPUs a bit, but far blocks can look sharper or blockier than usual textures.
rendersnap.option.entities.tooltip: Skips non-player entities when their chunk section is not part of Minecraft's visible terrain section.
rendersnap.option.behind_cam.tooltip: Normal skips rendering far entity and translucent work behind you to improve performance. The High setting also skips rendering of terrain sections not visible to the player's view behind the camera.
rendersnap.option.light_cache.tooltip: Caches distant light reads while chunks build. If far lighting looks stale, turn it off and refresh chunks or restart the game.
rendersnap.option.fog_occlusion.tooltip: Skips terrain sections behind vanilla fog. Heavy fog benefits more, but sky and fog edges may look rough in some areas.
rendersnap.option.fluid.tooltip: Samples nearby light for water and lava during chunk builds. Disable it if fluids look wrong with your pack or shader.
rendersnap.option.weather.tooltip: Stops rain, snow, and weather particles from drawing.
rendersnap.option.fast_launch.tooltip: Gives a performance boost during the first few seconds after launching the game. Disable it if you see weird chunk building or visual bugs during game launch.
rendersnap.toast.reload.title: Restart Recommended
rendersnap.toast.reload.body: Rendersnap settings have changed. Restart the game for a successful reload.
